name: Clover Biopharmaceuticals, Ltd.
summary: Clover Biopharmaceuticals, Ltd., established in 2007 and based in Shanghai, discovers, develops and commercializes vaccines and biological therapies for infectious diseases, cancer and autoimmune conditions. Its pipeline includes the SCB-2019 COVID-19 vaccine candidate in Phase II/III, SCB-313 for malignant effusions, SCB-808 in Phase III for rheumatic disorders, and preclinical SCB-420 and SCB-219. It has a supply agreement with Dynavax for its CpG 1018 adjuvant.
